question: According to the census of India 2011, the lowest female literacy rate was recorded in the state of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Census of India 2011**, the state with the Lowest** female literacy rate** was **Bihar**.
 
• The female literacy rate in Bihar was recorded at 53.33%, which was one of the lowest among states.
 
• States Female literacy
 
• **Maharashtra**: The female literacy rate in Maharashtra was recorded at **82.34%** in 2011.
 
• **Chhattisgarh**: The female literacy rate in Chhattisgarh was recorded at **70.25%** in 2011.
 
• **West Bengal**: The female literacy rate in West Bengal was recorded at **76.26%** in 2011.
 
 
• the highest female literacy rate, which was in Kerala at **92.07%**.

 __Census 2011__

 
• The Indian Census is the most credible source of information on Demography (Population characteristics), Economic Activity, Literacy and Education, Housing Household Amenities, Urbanisation, Fertility and Mortality, etc. 
 
• Census 2011 was the 15th National Census of the Country.
 
• Census was introduced in India during the era of Lord Mayo in the year 1872. It came into force in 1881.
 
• This census was conducted under the guidance of Mr. C. Chandramouli.
 
• The slogan of census 2011 was ‘Our Census, Our future’.
 
• The population of the nation as per the provisional figures of Census 2011 was 1210.19 million of which 623.7 million (51.54%) were males and 586.46 million (48.46%) were females. Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India its population is more than the population of Brazil.
